_comment: Translates OpenLift Standard Anatomical Names (left side) to the real bone names in assets/base_body.blend (right side). Preset: MPFB 'Game engine' rig. A value can be one bone name or a list of bone names (each listed bone receives the full rotation). Run pipeline/validate_rig.py after changing the base mesh.

palm_reference._comment: Two knuckle bones per hand: the first-finger and little-finger base bones. Used to find the palm orientation and the grip point for props.

neutral_overrides._comment: Optional. Per standard bone: {"direction": [x, y, z]} replaces the built-in neutral direction (Blender axes: +X = character's left, -Y = forward, +Z = up). Leave empty unless a pose looks consistently wrong.
